purpose: Literature-bounded Mars scenario with explicit approximations; not calibrated site photometry
dust_spectral_model: Grey RGB approximation to an 880 nm scenario opacity; no measured wavelength conversion or phase function
provenance: Radius follows the DEM reference body. Gas scale height 11 km and Sun distance use nominal NASA values. Tau880=0.45 is a scenario inside a published early Jezero range of 0.4-0.5, not a chosen sol measurement. Grey SSA=0.93 is a scenario motivated by TES solar-band fits of 0.92-0.94, not a Jezero spectral retrieval. Dust height=11 km is an assumed exponential profile, independently configurable from gas. RGB Rayleigh values, anisotropy, terrain colour, 30 klux, exposure and sun pose remain uncalibrated. No Earth ozone layer, extra fog, synthetic collision rocks or fabricated relief. A single grey Henyey-Greenstein aerosol cannot validate Mars sky colours or its blue sunset aureole.
